items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Sol used to come every once in a while, drop in to our concerts down at the Donnell Library.

ctx.x: You ever run into Sol Yaged?
Yes. Sol used to come every once in a while, drop in to our concerts down at the Donnell Library.
Yeah. Who do you listen to these days?
